question: Subsidiary Alliance was a system devised by _______ in 1798
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Wellesley.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subsidiary Alliance** was a system introduced by **Lord Wellesley in 1798.**
 
• The system was devised as a means to **strengthen British power** in India and to** establish control** over the **princely states.**
 
• Under the system, the Indian ruler was required to **accept British protection and assistance** in return for ceding control of their **foreign affairs **and allowing British troops to be stationed in their territory.
 
• The system was also used as a means to **extract revenue** from the princely states and to prevent them from forming alliances with other** European powers.**
 
• Lord Wellesley's Subsidiary Alliance system was a significant factor in the** consolidation of British power** in India and played a key role in the eventual establishment of British colonial rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Lord Bentinck** was the **Governor-General of India** from **1828 to 1835.**

 
 
• He is known for his social reforms, including **abolition of Sati and suppression of Thuggee.**
 
 
 
• **Lord Dalhousie **was the **Governor-General of India** from **1848 to 1856.**
 
 
• He is known for his policies of annexation, including the **annexation of Punjab, **and for introducing the **Doctrine of Lapse.**
 
 
 
• **Lord Hastings **was the **Governor-General of India** from **1813 to 1823.**
 
 
• He is known for his military campaigns against the** Marathas and the Pindaris.**
